messages.author: a0f8ae60bd31a713
messages.subject: error in anova
parts:
Hi everyone,

I was re-running some analysis, and I get the following error when using the anova function from RRPP to compare these three models:

fit1 <- procD.lm(coords ~ logSize , data = dombeyi.gdf, print.progress = FALSE)
fit2 <- procD.lm(coords ~ logSize * leaf, data = dombeyi.gdf, print.progress = FALSE)           
fit3 <- procD.lm(coords ~ logSize * faltitude/leaf,  data = dombeyi.gdf, print.progress = FALSE) 

Error in -anova(fit1, fit2, fit3) : invalid argument to unary operator.

I don't really understand what is going on, as model comparison was working ok until last night. If I run the individual models both summary and anova output work perfectly. Is just when I attempt to compare the 3 models that get the error message. Any clues of what Im doing wrong here?

Any help will be greatly appreciated

Giselle

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] error in anova
parts:
Giselle,

When confronted with an error like yours - one that arises without any package updates - my course of action is this:

1. Restart R.  If this does not work,
2. Restart computer and restart R.  If this does not work,
3. Reinstall R (and R studio) and relaunch.  If this does not work,
4. Make sure to update all packages that could be at fault (geomorph, RRPP, and dependencies).  If that does not work,
5. Debug

The debug part is the geomorph and RRPP teams' responsibility, so if the first four fail, then let us know.

The type of error you received is unusual.  It makes me suspect that R is having a seizure.  When R has a seizure, updating R might be needed.

Try this sequence and then let us know if you still have problems.

Cheers!
Mike
